newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai Post changes 1996 offer plan.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai Post changes 1996 offer plan.

text.p: Shareholders of Shanghai Post and Telecommunications Co have rejected a plan to offer only a dividend for fiscal year 1996, ordering the firm to add a three-for-10 bonus share issue, a company statement said on Wednesday.
The shareholders at a meeting on Tuesday approved a proposal by the firm's board of directors to offer a pre-tax cash dividend of 0.1 yuan per share based on 1996 net profit, the statement said.
But they decided the firm must also add a one-for-10 bonus share issue based on the 1996 net profit and a two-for-10 bonus share issue based on the firm's capital reserves, it added.
The company recorded a 1996 net profit of 27.743 million yuan, sharply down from 41.565 million yuan for 1995, based on international accounting standards.
The company has yet to announce ex-dividend and ex-rights dates and the exchange rate for the dividend for foreign currency B shares.
